685ca9c0.text:
Too often people like the followers of the Holy Light scare those curious about true power into thinking they cannot investigate any form of the arcane--not all things from outside this world are evil. Not all entities seek to dominate or subjugate others. If you are powerful enough, those same entities can become the followers.

This is something I would like to discuss more with you. Seek me out in the graveyard on the right side of the abbey.

-Drusilla La Salle, $C Trainer
685ca9c0.title: Tainted Letter

c0c97460.text:
Osric,

Please find below the list of armor of which we are in need:  

10 Mail shirts
20 Helms
30 Armor Patches
15 Mail Boots

We are, as always, in your debt.  And should Westfall ever be free of the thieves who threaten it, it would ease the guilt in my heart if I could invite you to my family's home, for a fine meal cooked from the bounty this land was once so well known.

-Lewis
Quartermaster, Sentinel Hill
c0c97460.title: Lewis' Note

c2e3dc0a.text:
There are four rules to magic:

   Magic is powerful.
   Magic is corrupting.
   Magic is addicting.
   Magic draws the denizens of the Twisting Nether to those who wield the arcane.

Those rules you can always guarantee. Those rules will govern your destiny if you chose to continue down the path as a $c.

If you're foolish enough to ignore this warning, then come speak to me inside the library wing of the abbey in Northshire. I'll be waiting for you upstairs.

-Khelden Bremen, $C Trainer
c2e3dc0a.title: Glyphic Letter

c562b99e.text:
REPORT: Kobolds

The activity of kobolds has increased in the vicinity of Northshire Valley.  They camp north of the abbey and within the Echo Ridge Mine in alarming numbers.  I have marshalled paladins, warriors and other local folk to aid me in ridding us of the vermin.

This progresses well.  And I will update as needed.
c562b99e.title: Marshal McBride's Documents

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

241|2823b3ed.name: Remy "Two Times"
241|2823b3ed.text: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do. Would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|466d697a.name: Daniel
247229|466d697a.text:
Professions are divided between two main categories: primary and secondary.

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time; however, the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. If you choose to return to your original profession, you will need to train from the basics and seek out recipes you previously acquired to refamiliarize yourself with them.

Secondary professions do not have such a limit. These skills tend to err towards self-sufficiency with your basic survival needs. You are free to train any or all of these, but may find fewer opportunities to turn a profit.

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

247229|58cf691f.name: Daniel
247229|58cf691f.text:
I am glad you asked!

Professions are skills pertaining to crafting, gathering, and general survival. There are many to choose from, with each offering their own unique benefits and economic opportunities. Whether you seek wealth, an opportunity to stock your guild's warehouse with useful items, or simply enjoy the satisfaction of wearing equipment crafted by your own hand, there's a profession for that.

Crafting recipes can be learned from trainers, such as those around here, and numerous other sources across Azeroth. Once learned, you can craft as many of that item as you wish, provided you can acquire the necessary materials.

247229|83e0509a.name: Daniel
247229|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

247229|b3334d4d.name: Daniel
247229|b3334d4d.text:
Of course! Which profession would you like me to guide you towards?

I will mark your map with the location of a local trainer of your choice. Remember that you can visit trainers in capital cities for more thorough training.

247229|e9b56518.name: Daniel
247229|e9b56518.text: Great choice. I have marked that location on your map.

248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining. With thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.
